I am 38 years old and I have farmed my 5 mu in Quzhou County for 13 years. I finished middle school. My household has five people. My wife and I do most of the field work, my parents help when they can, and my younger brother works in a factory in Handan city and sends money home. Our budget is tight, so every yuan I spend in the field matters.

Right now it is April. My winter wheat is already in the ground from last October. I use an improved wheat variety that the seed dealer in town sells. It is not the most expensive seed, but my neighbor Lao Zhang planted it last year and got about 900 jin per mu, so I copied him. Last autumn I deep-ploughed and then broadcast one 80-jin bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu and half a bag of urea per mu before sowing. That is already done. Now in spring, I will topdress 40 jin of urea per mu at the jointing stage. I will irrigate twice more: once right after topdressing so the fertilizer melts into the soil, and once at heading if it stays dry. Running the pump costs about 15 yuan per mu each time, so I count every irrigation, but I cannot let the wheat go thirsty during grain filling. I will spray pesticide twice: one time for powdery mildew and one time for aphids. Last year I got about 450 kg per mu and I expect the same this year if the frost did not hurt the crop.

After I harvest the wheat in early June, I immediately plant summer maize. I never let the land sit idle — in Quzhou we have to race the season. I rotary-till right after the combine finishes. I plant a hybrid maize, the Zhengdan 958 type. At planting I put down one 80-jin bag of compound fertilizer per mu and half a bag of urea. Then at big trumpet stage I side-dress another 40 jin of urea per mu. I know some people say less is enough, but I watched what works. Two years ago Chen from West Village cut his fertilizer to save money and his ears were half-empty. I would rather waste some fertilizer than face that disaster. I will irrigate twice: once after sowing if it does not rain within three days, and once at the filling stage. I spray herbicide after emergence and one insecticide spray in July for corn borer. I expect about 550 kg per mu.

I think hard about costs. A bag of compound fertilizer is about 130 yuan and urea is about 90 yuan now. For 5 mu I need 10 bags of compound and several bags of urea for both crops — over 2,500 yuan just for chemical fertilizer. But I do not dare cut back. My family depends on this harvest. If everyone around me applies this much, I apply this much. Change is dangerous. A bad harvest means my child's school fees are in trouble. Wasting 100 yuan on extra urea is nothing compared to losing half a crop.
